doc.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011

title: His mother's support and records
summary: His mother took him to shows and bought Lester Young and Coltrane records.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Rewinding way back, I remember your mother being very supportive of you.
She seemed to really be behind you.

Yeah, and as far as practicing and all that, and I mean we went to shows and I went to see Ray Charles and a lot of the shows that came to Utica she bought me records, like Lester Young records and John Coltrane records, which I didn’t check out at first. You know I’d put it on and I’d be like well it’s all right. But then later on I’d be like listening to it intently for hours and hours. She definitely was a big influence on my musical world.
